description: Configure the Magento store for multi-currency international sales. 1) Go to Stores > Configuration > General > Currency Setup. Add EUR (Euro), GBP (British Pound Sterling), and CAD (Canadian Dollar) to 'Allowed Currencies' (ensure USD remains selected). Keep 'Default Display Currency' as USD. Save Config. 2) Go to Stores > Currency > Currency Rates. Set the following manual exchange rates from USD: EUR = 0.9200, GBP = 0.7900, CAD = 1.3600. Save Currency Rates. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
